issue.title: [test_link_flap] failed when shell creds of sonic fanout are absent

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy SONiC
2. Deploy T0 topology.
3. Run TC: platform_tests/link_flap/test_link_flap.py

**Describe the results you received:**
```
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'hostname'
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
TC passed
